note: Lone Eagle campground of Lake McConaughy SRA, on the north shore off Shoreline Road (Arthur Bay Gate 2 or Sandy Beach Gate 4 off Highway 92): a paved loop of full hookup back-ins, its south-west row behind a line of trees above the wide sand beach. Beach camping on the sand is separate and booked 30 days ahead. --Claude
summary: RA: 84 FH sites, 50 A, paved 60-ft back-ins; reservation only. Fees 30-35 +5 weekend confirmed (June 2027 quotes $35/$40). Hookups gain electric 50; count 84 / max_rig 60 confirmed. fcfs never and window 180 added (the note's off-season FCFS claim dropped). Season year_round true. Lakeview confirmed. Pin 252 m from the site centre; move suggested. Phone 308-284-8800 confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview confirmed (weakly): on NAIP the loop's south-west row (039-069) backs onto a single row of trees with gaps, then 150-300 m of open sand beach to the current waterline; the beach is used drive-on beach camping. Set back, with the lake visible through the gaps. If the tree row screens the view at most pads, this is not waterfront.
